text: Computer vision is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, where a computer can identify what is in a picture, such as a cat or a person. Another key task is object detection, which means finding and locating objects within an image. Computer vision has many applications in our daily lives. For example, it is used in security cameras to detect unusual activity, in hospitals to examine medical images, and in self-driving cars to recognise roads, signs, and other vehicles. Thanks to computer vision, machines can "see" and make smart decisions based on what they observe.
